instruction.thesis: The BTC put-call exhaustion/reversal thesis (H-069 promoted via H-523) predicted a spot bounce following the P/C spike. The IBIT P/C ratio peaked at 0.919 at T14 and has since normalized to 0.735 — the exhaustion signal has resolved without a meaningful spot bounce. BTC spot has drifted from entry $76,989 to $76,416 (-0.74%), sitting at the 21st percentile of its 24h range with no upward momentum. The vol expansion (PM IV 47.1%) has occurred but is not driving spot higher. With 40h remaining on a 72h expiry window and the signal having resolved without the predicted directional move, the thesis is invalidated. The stop is at -1.5% ($75,901) and current price is approaching that level; closing now to preserve capital rather than risk a stop-out.
